author: Akiana
title: Looking for artist for YouTube/Twitter headers and Twitch panels
content:
Hii artists! ❤️❤️

author: Timofey lobanok
title: Looking for illustrator for light novel
content:
I'm looking for a talented illustrator for my light novel!

I'm searching for someone who can create expressive characters, capture emotions, and bring the story to life in an anime/manga-inspired style.

#ArtistWanted #Illustrator #LightNovel #AnimeArt #MangaArt #CommissionOpen

If you're interested, or if you know someone who might be a great fit, feel free to send me a DM or drop a link to your portfolio in the comments.

I'd love to hear from you! 🎨✨
